method: Read-only source-time inspection of recorded complete ROS joint samples near five original no-feasible cycles. 20/50/100ms position differences are diagnostic scale comparisons, not a physical-velocity ground truth or a proposed deployed filter.

code_path_findings.can_time_origin: piper_protocol_v2.py:69 can_time_now=rx_can_frame.timestamp; feedback branches12/34/56 each set msg.time_stamp to that CAN receive timestamp, not a shared hardware sampling epoch
code_path_findings.sdk_joint_aggregate: piper_interface.py:1763-1794 stores three pair updates into one six-position object; every pair update overwrites the single time_stamp
code_path_findings.driver_acceptance: piper_ctrl_single_node.py:559-574 requires all three pair counters to advance, per-pair arrival ages<0.15s, pair spread<0.05s; copies six positions under SDK lock, one shared last-update stamp
code_path_findings.driver_velocity: piper_ctrl_single_node.py:594-601 computes each dq=(q-old_q)/(shared_stamp-old_shared_stamp); no motor_speed field is used
code_path_findings.mppi_input: whole_body_mppi.py:328-344 trusts finite fresh position/velocity arrays, checks q bounds, then stores dq as the measured initial velocity; no independent velocity estimate or compatibility check
code_path_findings.sdk_zeroing_exclusion: __CalJointSDKLimit at1668 only clips to joint range when enabled; this code does not zero small near-zero positions
code_path_findings.unrecorded: Raw CAN pair payloads, independent per-pair source receive stamps/counters, and high-speed per-motor speed are absent from bag, so the exact source of position stair steps/zero toggles cannot be proved or attributed to firmware/hardware from this record alone.

repair_location_assessment.driver: The derivative is generated in the driver, but changing SDK/CAN/raw position acquisition is not necessary to resolve how planning consumes derivative estimates; touching the hardware interface would widen this fix. SDK pair stamps would need raw CAN evidence to prove the specific timing distortion.
repair_location_assessment.mppi_only: A source-time velocity estimator only in whole_body_mppi.on_joints is a narrow experiment, but leaves REMANI consuming exactly the same pulsed velocity on /mm/joint_states and permits inconsistent slow/fast initial states.
repair_location_assessment.shared_existing_input: Preferred small integration point: use the existing filter_joint_states path to provide one explicit source-time velocity estimate to /mm/joint_states, and route MPPI to that same feedback topic. Preserve raw /joint_states_single and hardware driver; keep position/stamp freshness independent; validate the estimator against recorded motion rather than treating a 50/100ms mean as truth. This is a proposed location, not an implemented or validated filter.
